description.narrative: (Uganda): HCWM will be implemented by a local Ugandan-owned hazardous waste management firm. With FY 2022 MCH and FP funds, HCWM will use a health systems strengthening approach to remediate the potential human health and environmental impacts of maternal, newborn, child health, and family planning related hazardous health care waste through safe and proper segregation, collection, storage, transportation, treatment, and disposal. This activity will be conducted in accordance with the National Environmental Management Authority, the Ministry of Health Waste Management guidelines, and USAID's environment compliance standards. The activity will support facilities to properly manage health care waste when they carry out outreaches and mobile clinics during service disruptions caused by climatic conditions..
